slots.label: Input card slot
slots.note: H-series input cards, up to 40 input channels (HDMI/DVI/SDI/DP/VGA/CVBS cards)

slots.label: Output card slot
slots.note: sending cards e.g. H_16xRJ45+2xfiber, H_20xRJ45; up to 12 output channels

slots.label: Control card
slots.note: H_Control: Ethernet, USB, RS232, power switch

notes: No NovaStar H5 spec sheet found; chassis figures from reseller pages (17 kg net chassis, 400 W, 100-240 V). One PSU, backup PSU optional. LED outputs depend on fitted sending cards (not listed as ports). Control-card ports from H-series manual; RS232 connector type unknown (omitted), genlock port not described.
